column1: # Membrane-mimetic samples the class rule of trizod/bmrb/membrane.py cannot see:
# no _Sample_component, _Sample.Type, _Sample.Details, _Sample.Solvent_system or
# _Sample.Name of the chain's samples names the mimetic; only the entry title (or
# the assembly name, the entry details, the sample-condition details, the
# citation, the structure keywords, or a shift list's name or values) does.
# Each row was reviewed against the raw NMR-STAR file of the 2026-11-11 snapshot
# 15305_2_1_1, 51798_2_1_1 and the LPS rows). Titles are never matched
# automatically.
# id:     a BMRB entry ID (every chain of the entry) or a chain ID
#         <entry>_<shift table>_<entity assembly>_<entity> (that chain only)
# class:  a MIMETIC_CLASSES label of trizod/bmrb/membrane.py
# reason: where the evidence is, quoted
# Reviewed and NOT listed (the chain's own sample is aqueous, or the evidence does
# not attach to the deposited sample): 16514, 19253, 5494_1_1_1, 6068, 7233,
# 7168_3_1_1 (two-state entries, chain measured in buffer); 15717 (the bicelle
# sample is the RDC alignment sample); 3436 (a water/micelle comparison, the
# deposited condition is not stated); 34608 (no lipid in any NMR sample); 36005
# (calmodulin in the water pool of a CTAB reverse micelle); 16071, 16075-16080,
# 17720, 19713, 30180 (a keyword only, samples in buffer); and every title that
# names a protein (lipid-transfer/-binding proteins, StAR lipid-transfer
# domains, Sds3, lipid-free apoE).
# LPS policy (re-audit 2026-11-17b, item 4): lipopolysaccharide micelles and
# bilayers are membrane mimetics, everywhere and consistently. An LPS sample
# component, _Sample.Type or sample text is classified by the rule (class LPS in
# trizod/bmrb/membrane.py), so no override is kept for it (20060, component
# "YI12FF+LPS", was removed). The rows of class LPS below are LPS samples named
# only outside the sample (title, assembly name, citation): peptide structures
# from transferred-NOE (trNOESY) or bound-state spectra recorded on the one
# deposited sample, which therefore holds the LPS.
# Reviewed for LPS and NOT listed: 34778 (sample in 50 % TFE, no LPS), 11539
# ("Tachyplesin I in water"), 18350 (citation only, aqueous sample), 4643 (TFE),
# the anti-lipopolysaccharide factors (15622, 18363) and the Lpt LPS-transport
